challenges.name: delivery-history-pager
challenges.title: Page the delivery history with cursors
challenges.description: The courier's delivery history (hundreds of orders) used offset paging: new orders arriving at the top shifted the offsets, so couriers saw the same delivery twice; a fast fling requested the same page twice; and a page that arrived after a pull-to-refresh was appended to the fresh list. The list now pages with server cursors (`next` = the cursor for the following page, null at the end), like a Paging 3 `PagingSource`. The editor holds the `Pager` with its blocks missing, each marked by a `// [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Fill every line so that: refresh starts over from the newest orders, even after the end was reached; a page is requested when the last visible item is within `prefetch` of the end, never while another request is loading and never after the end; a refresh page replaces the list, other pages are appended and update the cursor and the end; and any page requested before the latest refresh changes nothing. Run scrolls, delivers server answers and adds new orders, and prints the list after each step.
hints: Follow the cursor: where does the key of each request come from, what does a page do to it, and what must a refresh reset so that scrolling works again afterwards?
Check the guards: a request while `loading`, a request after `endReached`, and a page whose `gen` is not the current `generation`. Each one is a bug from the old list.

A chat history loader: `fun loadOlder() { if (!loading && hasMore) { loading = true; send(Req(oldestId, gen)) } }`, `fun onBatch(req: Req, batch: Batch) { if (req.gen != gen) return; messages += batch.items; oldestId = batch.next; hasMore = batch.next != null; loading = false }`, `fun reset() { gen++; oldestId = null; hasMore = true; ... }`.

tests.name: Pages load near the end of the list and stop at the last one
tests.input:
refresh
deliver
scroll 2
scroll 3
deliver
scroll 8
deliver
scroll 11
tests.expected:
refresh -> items=0 [] next=null end=false loading=true pending=1 dupes=0
deliver -> items=5 [1000..996] next=996 end=false loading=false pending=0 dupes=0

scroll 3 -> items=5 [1000..996] next=996 end=false loading=true pending=1 dupes=0
deliver -> items=10 [1000..991] next=991 end=false loading=false pending=0 dupes=0
scroll 8 -> items=10 [1000..991] next=991 end=false loading=true pending=1 dupes=0
deliver -> items=12 [1000..989] next=null end=true loading=false pending=0 dupes=0
scroll 11 -> items=12 [1000..989] next=null end=true loading=false pending=0 dupes=0
